title.en: The gradient of a linear model

hints.tr: İleri geçiş: $\hat{y} = 0{,}5 + 1 + 0 = 1{,}5$. $\frac{\partial L}{\partial w_j} = 2(\hat{y} - y) x_j$.
hints.en: Forward pass: $\hat{y} = 0.5 + 1 + 0 = 1.5$. $\frac{\partial L}{\partial w_j} = 2(\hat{y} - y) x_j$.

hints.tr: $\frac{\partial L}{\partial b} = 2(\hat{y} - y) = -3$. Yeni parametrelerle $\hat{y}$'yi yeniden hesapla.
hints.en: $\frac{\partial L}{\partial b} = 2(\hat{y} - y) = -3$. Recompute $\hat{y}$ with the new parameters.
